sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Akshaya Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
Heard Sri Akshaya Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Jhamman Ram, learned AGA for the State-respondent.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 533 of 2022, under Sections 411, 414, 413, 420, 468, 471 IPC and 3/25 Arms Act, Police Station- Chandausi, District- Sambhal, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

FIR of the present case was lodged on 12.12.2022 against applicant and four others and according to the FIR, applicant and four others were apprehended by the police and on their pointing out 10 two-wheelers were recovered from the house of the applicant and all the two-wheelers were stolen one and applicant and others were using the same after changing its chassis, number plate etc.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the entire allegations made against the applicant are totally false and baseless and nothing incriminating was recovered from the possession of applicant and on the basis of false recovery, applicant has been made accused in the present matter along with four others.

He further submitted that along with applicant co-accused Aman was also apprehended but he has Sakim vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115860288/
1 been released on bail.
He filed the bail order of co-accused Aman, along with the instant bail application.
He further submitted that applicant was not having any criminal history and he is in jail, in the present matter since 12.12.2022.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that from the house of the applicant on the pointing of the applicant and others, 10 stolen two-wheelers were recovered but could not dispute the fact that all the offences are triable by Magistrate-I Class and co-accused Aman who was also arrested along with applicant, has been released on bail and applicant is not having any previous criminal history.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

As per allegation, from the house of the applicant on the pointing out of applicant and four others,
10 stolen two-wheelers were recovered but all the offences are triable by Magistrate-I Class and co-accused Aman who was arrested along with applicant has been released on bail.
Applicant in the present matter is in jail since 12.12.2022, therefore, considering the above facts and circumstances of the case, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant- Sakim be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

Order Date :- 23.3.2023 KK Patel  Sakim vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115860288/
